description: This file defines the Security class within the PhpOffice\PhpSpreadsheet\Document namespace, handling document security features such as locking revision, structure, and windows, as well as managing passwords for revisions and the workbook.

classes.name: Security
classes.description: A class managing security settings for a spreadsheet document, including lock options and password management.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Creates a new instance of the Security class.

methods.name: isSecurityEnabled
methods.description: Checks if any security features (revision, structure, or window locking) are enabled.

methods.name: getLockRevision
methods.description: Returns whether revision locking is enabled.

methods.name: getLockStructure
methods.description: Returns whether structure locking is enabled.

methods.name: getLockWindows
methods.description: Returns whether window locking is enabled.

methods.name: setRevisionsPassword
methods.description: Sets the password for revisions, optionally hashing it.

methods.name: getWorkbookPassword
methods.description: Retrieves the password for the workbook.

methods.name: setWorkbookPassword
methods.description: Sets the password for the workbook, optionally hashing it.
